name: ticketure-retail-estimate
description: Apps Script web app that saves retail/F&B client estimates to the Ticketure Retail Estimates sheet.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.deploy: npm run push && clasp deploy --description "$(git log -1 --pretty=%s)"
